text:
Marta: Quick heads-up — planning a small runtime push tonight (kernel 2.14.1 + quant profile alpha-3). Slot 02:00 UTC, 15m window. Need an owner + smoke partner. TLDR: low-risk but touches embeddings path.

Sahil: I can own the slot. I'll be on-call at that time. @Leo want to pair for smoke?

Leo: Yep I can smoke. What are the rollback steps?

Marta: Rollback is simple: apply previous kernel image tag and restart slices. Commands:
```
kubectl set image ds/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:2.14.0 && kubectl rollout status ds/runtime -n prod
```
Validate KV and perf with:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" https://serving.example.com/health
./smoke-check.sh --min-rps 50 --kv-lat 50ms
```
(If smoke script fails, revert immediately and mark for postmortem)

Sahil: PR for quant profile + kernel bump: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/4123 
Code review pinged @Jen

Jen: Reviewing now. Small nit in config, will approve in 30m.

Marta: opsbot will run a quick preflight at 01:30 UTC. If any preflight check fails — abort and reschedule.

opsbot: preflight scheduled by Marta for 2026-03-18T01:30:00Z. Checks: image checksum, slot capacity, canary health.

Leo: What telemetry thresholds should I watch during smoke?

Marta: Watch token-per-sec per slot, p99 latency, and kv miss rate. If p99 > 250ms or kv miss > 5% escalate and rollback. Also watch error-rate spike > 0.5%.

Sahil: I'll post a short status update right before swap and after smoke. ETA finish smoke ~02:20 UTC.

Jen: Approved, leaving a deploy note in PR.

Marta: Timeline for clarity: preflight 01:30, deploy 02:00-02:15, smoke 02:15-02:25, final signoff 02:30. If anything odd, pause and debug — don't rush. :thumbsup:

Leo: Copy. I'll be standing by for rollback and will kick if thresholds breach.

Sahil: Thanks — will bump this thread with live status during the window.
